features: 3.2-10mm motorized varifocal lens (simple focus), DC auto iris
BNC output: AHD 4M/2M, TVI 2M, CVI 2M, CVBS selectable
Motion detection (4 zones), privacy masking (16 rectangle / 8 polygon)
Coax control: ACP (AHD), TCP (TVI), CCP (CVI), Pelco-C (CVBS)
release_notes: Specs per official Hanwha Vision Japanese user manual (Manuals_HCD-7080R,HCV-7080R,HCO-7080R_231223_JA.pdf, translated), HCD-7080R column. 5MP sensor with 4MP (2560x1440) max output. B/W min. illumination is stated only as 0 Lux (IR LED on), so it is not recorded. Power consumption (max 8W) is shared across the three models.
